toolLengthMethod.description: Tool length measurement method (0=Fixed position, 1=Surface plate)

ATCType.description: ATC types supported by the system

ATCValidationResult.description: ATC validation result DTO for ATC configuration validation

label.description: Axis label (X, Y, Z, A, B, C, U, V, W)

turnRatio.description: Turn ratio - distance per revolution (inches/mm per rev for linear, degrees for rotary)

fastJogPlusDirection.description: Fast jog rate in plus direction

fastJogMinusDirection.description: Fast jog rate in minus direction

homingFeedrate.description: Homing feedrate - the feedrate that the machine will run at to home each axis

masterAxis.description: Master axis for pairing (0 = none, 1-8 = master axis number)

isRotary.description: Whether this is a rotary axis (Parameter bit 0)

rotaryWrapAround.description: Rotary DRO wrap around display mode (Parameter bit 1)

preventDivideBy360.description: Prevent divide by 360 for C-Axis (Parameter bit 7)

hideFromDRO.description: Hide axis from DRO display - ATC Turret (Parameter bit 9)

parallelToX.description: Rotary axis parallel to X (Parameter bit 11)

parallelToY.description: Rotary axis parallel to Y (Parameter bit 12)

stepSignalInverted.description: Invert step signal for this axis (Parameter 961 - 4-bit nibble per axis)

directionSignalInverted.description: Invert direction signal for this axis (Parameter 961 - 4-bit nibble per axis)

enableSignalInverted.description: Invert enable signal for this axis (Parameter 961 - 4-bit nibble per axis)

isRunning.description: Whether the CNC server is currently running

weStartedServer.description: Whether we started the server (and can manage it)

canStart.description: Whether the server can be started

canStop.description: Whether the server can be stopped

canRestart.description: Whether the server can be restarted

data.description: Array of data items to save in the checkpoint

CompleteMachineConfiguration.description: Complete machine configuration DTO for API

ConfigurationDataRequest.description: Request model for configuration data operations

driveFaultDelay.description:
Axis Motor Drive fault delay time (milliseconds)
Global drive fault delay for all axes

lowResolutionMode.description: Low resolution mode for plasma systems

chargePumpDivider.description:
Divider for charge pump frequency. 0 = turned off, 96 = default (12.5kHz)
Formula: 1,200,000 / divider = frequency in Hz

totalLines.description: Total number of lines in the job

isStepRunMode.description: Whether the job is in step run mode

stepLineNumber.description: Current step line number in step run mode

JobDetails.description: Response model for detailed job information

MachinePoint.description: Represents a point in machine coordinates with X, Y, Z, and A axis values

OverrideIORequest.description: Request model for IO override operations

outputNumber.description: Output number for PWM signal - Required

sCommandRange1000.description: PWM S command range: true = 0-1000, false = 0-100 (parameter 815, bit 1)

floor.description: PWM floor value (minimum duty cycle percentage)

onlyApplyFloorDuringVelocityMoves.description: Only apply floor during PWM velocity modulation moves (parameter 815, bit 2)

laserCoolingFanDelayTimer.description: Laser cooling fan delay timer in seconds (parameter 998)

isInverted.description: Whether PWM signal is inverted (legacy property - use InverseOutput instead)

inverseEnabled.description: Inverse enable bit (legacy property - use InverseOutput instead)

velocity100.description: Velocity 100% mode (legacy property - use SCommandRange1000 instead)

ParameterInfo.description: Parameter information DTO for available parameters

ParameterSetRequest.description: Request model for setting individual parameters

ParameterValue.description: Parameter value DTO for parameter operations

probeProtectionBasedOnToolNumber.description: Probe protection based on tool number

displayWarningToVerifyProbe.description: Display warning to verify that probe is functioning properly

inhibitSpindleWhenDetectOn.description: Inhibit spindle when detect is on (Green)

probeSlowJogSpeeds.description:
Probe slow jog speeds for each axis (in/min)
Array index corresponds to axis (0=Axis1, 1=Axis2, etc.)

probeFastJogNegativeSpeeds.description:
Probe fast jog negative speeds for each axis (in/min)
Array index corresponds to axis (0=Axis1, 1=Axis2, etc.)

probeFastJogPositiveSpeeds.description:
Probe fast jog positive speeds for each axis (in/min)
Array index corresponds to axis (0=Axis1, 1=Axis2, etc.)

inputNumber.description: Probe input number (legacy - use ProbePLCInput instead)

inputType.description: Probe input type (legacy - use InputStateWhenTripped instead)

feedRate.description: Probe feed rate (legacy - use FastProbeRate/SlowProbeRate instead)

touchPlateInputNumber.description: Touch plate input number (if different from probe)

probeTypeInt.description: Probe type configuration (legacy - use ProbeType enum instead)

displayProbeWarning.description: Display probe warning (legacy - use DisplayWarningToVerifyProbe instead)

name.description: Unique name identifier for the storage item

exposeAsAction.description: Whether this storage should be exposed as an action

actionCategoryName.description: Action category name for exposure (if ExposeAsAction is true)

ProgramStorage.description: Represents a stored CNC program or MDI command

ResumeJobAtResponse.description: Response model for resume job at specific line operation

RunGCodeCommandRequest.description: Request model for running a single G-code command

RunGCodeCommandResponse.description: Response model for single G-code command execution

gCodeLines.description: Array of G-code lines to execute

gcodeParameterString.description: Optional parameter string to pass to the G-code program

startImmediately.description: Whether to start execution immediately or just create the job

RunGCodeResponse.description: Response model for G-code execution operations

encoderCounts.description: Second spindle encoder counts per revolution

SetOutputRequest.description: Request model for setting output values

spindleAxis.description: Spindle axis number (5 standard, 8 for AcornSix/Hickory)

durationForMinRigidTappingRPM.description: Duration For Min. Rigid Tapping RPM in seconds (Parameter 69)

mFuncBottomHoleG84.description: M Func To Run At Bottom Of Hole G84 Tapping

mFuncTopHoleG74Counter.description: M Func To Run At Top Of Hole For G74 Counter Tapping

mFuncBottomHoleG74LeftHand.description: M Func To Run At Bottom Of Hole G74 Tapping (Left Hand Taps)

mFuncTopHoleG84Counter.description: M Func To Run At Top Of Hole For G84 Counter Tapping

rigidTappingZAxisSyncDistance.description: Rigid Tapping Z Axis Sync Distance (Parameter 241)

doNotWaitForIndexPulse.description: Do Not Wait For Index Pulse (Parameter 36 bit 1)

StepFrequency.description:
Supported step frequencies for the stepper pulse rate
These are the only valid values supported by the Centroid system

StepFrequencyRequest.description: Request model for setting step frequency

results.description: Results for each job stop operation

StopAllJobsResponse.description: Response model for stop all jobs operation

SystemHardwareInfo.description: Represents system hardware detection and capabilities

isCNCConnected.description: Whether the CNC pipe connection is active

touchOffToolPLCInput.description: Touch Off Tool PLC input number (Parameter 44 for Mill, 244 for Lathe)

displayWarningToVerify.description: Display warning to verify that Tool Touch Off is functioning properly

inhibitSpindleWhenDetectOn.description: Inhibit spindle when detect is on (Green) (Parameter 257)

useFixedLocation.description: Use fixed tool touch off (TT) location (Parameter 17)

fixedLocationX.description: Fixed Tool Touch Off X position (machine coordinates) - G30 P3 X

fixedLocationY.description: Fixed Tool Touch Off Y position (machine coordinates) - G30 P3 Y

zClearanceHeight.description: Z Clearance Height for Auto moves to TT (machine coordinates) - G30 P3 Z

subtractHeightWhenSettingOffsets.description: Subtract height of TT when setting Tool Height Offsets (Parameter 3 bit 1)

ttHeight.description: TT Height - Height of touch-off device (Parameter 71)

detectInputNumber.description: Tool Touch Off Detect Input number for detection/protection (Parameter 257)

ToolTouchOffInputState.description: Tool touch off input state when triggered

inputType.description: Touch plate input type (0=Normally Open, 1=Normally Closed)

ValidationResult.description: Validation result DTO for configuration validation
